about: Second sealed set, written 2026-10-10 for the relevance gate and committed before any gate code. The first sealed set (sealed-2026-10-10.json) and the frozen 20 had been read while building, so neither can measure the gate honestly. None of these 30 repeats a request from either. Labels were written with the requests and are the grading key: `expect` lists every query that answers the request; an empty list means no source on this Mac holds the answer, and the right response is to say so, not to draw. `kind`: one-source (some query in the vocabulary answers it), no-source (nothing on this Mac does), drawing (an explanation, no query), vague (no clear referent; an honest no-source answer or a panel bound to one of `expect` both pass). The author also builds the gate, so this is held out by commit order, not blind. Do not edit to improve a score; add a new sealed file instead.
